# Curriculum Vitae

::: lead
Postdoctoral researcher working on active travel, cycling, spatial data, urban planning and mobility inequalities.

[Download full CV as PDF](docs/cv.pdf)
:::

## Profile

I am a mobility researcher with a background in transport planning, environmental management, data analytics and law. My work focuses on active travel, cycling, spatial data, urban interventions and social inequalities in mobility.

## Current position

### Postdoctoral Researcher in Urban Planning and Mobility

**Department of Geography, Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona**\
Barcelona, Spain · December 2024–present

- Working on the **ATRAPA** (*The Active Travel Backlash Paradox*) project.
- Developing spatial analysis of urban interventions and public response.
- Supporting the development of datasets linking active-travel interventions with electoral outcomes.
- Contributing to publications and collaborative work within GEMOTT.

## Previous employment

**Institute for Transport Studies, University of Leeds**\
Leeds, United Kingdom · April 2022–March 2024

- CRUSE project: national cycling uptake model for Ireland.
- Co-supervision of MSc students.
